watches.name: Cereal - Marshmallow Magic (Rampart Studio X Doug Bloodworth)
watches.description: Saturday mornings, now on your wrist. Rampart Studio brings the art of celebrated photorealist Doug Bloodworth—known for his richly detailed paintings of childhood favorites—to three hand-painted watch dials. Each hand-painted piece unique features a different colorful breakfast cereal floating in milk, capturing the joy of sugary breakfasts and cartoons before anyone had somewhere to be. These original miniature paintings bring color, nostalgia, and a little mischief to checking the time. Only three watches are currently available, each with its own cereal design. Fine art with a sweet tooth. watches.name: Chilllton
watches.description: The Chilllton is back . The original Chilllton transformed Haven’s compact mechanical chronograph with a swirling tie-dye dial—and quickly became one of the strangest, most joyful watches we ever made. It was even worn in the movie Knives Out. We thought it deserved another turn. The new Chilllton brings that unmistakable design back to the wrist: saturated color, controlled chaos, and a dial that refuses to disappear into a collection. Beneath it is the same kind of serious mechanical watchmaking that established the Chilton in the first place. More color. More character. More Chilllton. Most mechanical chronographs are designed to look technical, traditional, or important. The Chilllton has other plans. Its tie-dye dial turns the familiar three-register chronograph into something expressive and unexpected. Color moves across the dial while the crisp chronograph display keeps everything balanced, functional, and easy to read. It is bold without becoming a novelty and playful without compromising what makes a mechanical chronograph special. Powered by hand. Inside is the Swiss-made Sellita SW510 M , a hand-wound mechanical chronograph movement operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour. Wind it. Wear it. Try not to stare at it. Compact on purpose. At 38mm , the Chilllton offers the balanced proportions of a vintage chronograph without feeling delicate or undersized. The polished 316L stainless-steel case measures 47mm from lug to lug, giving the watch real presence while remaining exceptionally comfortable across a wide range of wrists. A lightweight titanium caseback completes the construction. It is colorful. It is mechanical. It is remarkably wearable. Built in house. Every Chilllton is assembled, regulated, and pressure-tested in-house by our watchmakers in the United States. Because underneath all that color is a watch built to be taken seriously. The Chilllton Precision with Personality. Winding: Manual Frequency: 28,800 Jewels: 23

watches.name: Dato Chronograph - Navy Blue
watches.description: Balance. Function. Minimalism. With a pulse. The Dato strips the chronograph down to its essentials and arranges them with intention. Twin registers. A clean outer track. A framed date at six anchoring the dial. The brushed steel case keeps it grounded, while sharp hands and a vivid color in the registers adds character without clutter: a reminder that utility doesn’t have to be sterile. Every element serves a role. Every detail earns its place. The Dato is a chronograph with personality, reduced to what matters. It’s unmistakably Haven. Assembled and regulated by our in-house watchmakers in the United States. watches.name: Chilton Flux Chronograph - Daybreak Blue
watches.description: Haven Wakes Up the Chronograph Seconds, Reimagined Instead of a conventional seconds hand moving above the dial, Flux uses a rotating disc that flows beneath it. Not a tick. A current. Hence, Flux. Color, Made In-House The center dial wasn’t ordered—it was UV printed in our own studio. It is the first component fabricated in-house by Haven, and the beginning of something new in American watchmaking. Hence, Daybreak . A true go-anywhere chronograph, designed to look—and function—like nothing else. 316L steel. Swiss movement. Assembled and regulated in the United States, with select components fabricated by our in-house watchmakers. Precision with personality. watches.name: Fallout - Haven X Rampart Studio
watches.description: The degenerate watchmakers at Rampart Studio asked for a collaboration. Against my better judgment , I said yes. They didn’t start from scratch. Instead, they found a box of dials left over from our First Ave collab—a run of just 50 pieces. They grabbed the dials, announced “These are ours now” and bolted out the door. They came back a week later. FIRST was stripped down to RS. The 7th Ave reference—gone. In fact, every detail we built in, reworked or erased. In its place, high-contrast color that cuts across the dial like damage. Unhinged. Completely unnecessary. And… annoyingly good. They said they want to call this watch, " BETRAYAL " I keep telling them, there is no betrayal! The collab with First Ave was an honor. They suggested " DIVORCE ". I said no. Finally, I gave in when they suggested “Fallout” Introducing The Haven x Rampart Studio - Fallout Obscenely Limited quantities. Powered by a Sellita 360 movement, this watch features a black dial with a distinctive brick-relief motif. Dial is painted in the USA, by Rampart Studio. Lumed details include the star at 12, RS at 1, and the 7 o’clock marker, while a black date window with white print sits cleanly at 3. The 120-click rotating bezel is finished in black with lumed numerals, framing a 39mm case—an ideal modern size. Crafted from 316L stainless steel, the case measures 12mm thick, 46mm lug-to-lug, and features a signed screw-down crown, delivering 20 ATM of water resistance. As with all Haven watches, the caseback is etched in relief with the Great Lakes. It comes with two bracelets: A Haven-engraved steel bracelet and a top-grade Rampart Studio leather strap with a purple liner, brushed rivets, and stitching that echoes the dial. Specifications: Diameter: Case 38mm, bezel 39mm Case Material: 316L steel. Great Lakes etched caseback Thickness: 12mm Resistance: 20ATM/677 feet Bezel: 120 click unidirectional bezel with multi-color countdown insert Lug-to-lug: 46mm Lug width: 20mm Strap/Bracelet: Steel coffin-link bracelet with signed clasp; and a top-grade Rampart Studio leather strap featuring a purple liner, brushed rivets, and stitching to match the dial. Caliber: Sellita SW360-1 Power Reserve: 56 hours Winding: Automatic Frequency: 28,800 Jewels: 31

watches.name: Chilluminati Chronograph - Fume
watches.description: Some watches keep time. The Chilluminati keeps secrets. The grey-black fumé dial fades from light to darkness, pulling the eye toward a layout that feels less designed than decoded. Dramatic black lume. The date hides at 9. No traditional hour markers. An unconventional minute track that creates a face that is balanced, and unsettling. Inspired by the symbols, secrecy, and seductive paranoia of the Illuminati. Compact, hand-wound, and impossible to mistake for anything else. You’re either in—or you’re not. Assembled and regulated by our in-house watchmakers in the United States. watches.name: Trotter GMT - Polar
watches.description: Haven doesn’t stand still. Recognized by industry insiders, including HODINKEE, the Trotter GMT dares to be original in a world crowded with homages. For a watch built to move, two things matter: all-day comfort and exceptional durability. A true 38mm case wears effortlessly, while 20 ATM of water resistance prepares it for wherever life takes you. Its Swiss mechanical GMT movement uses a fourth hand to track a second time zone. A thoughtful 24-hour scale sits close to the center of the dial, keeping the design compact, functional, and unmistakably Trotter. Available in three distinct colorways : Midnight, Aqua, and Polar—an outrageous full-lume dial. Ready for wherever you’re headed—even if that’s only one step farther than yesterday. Built for distance. Distinctly Haven. 316L steel. Assembled and regulated by our in-house watchmakers in the United States. Precision with personality.
